prompt: [Character / Subject], Gongbi fine-line illustration × Eastern allegorical narrative × Japanese painting-style dense biological description. The subject is shaped with extremely fine ink lines and transparent light washes; skin, hands, hair, or fabrics are depicted with high-density directional fine lines, precise in detail but maintaining overall flatness. The background uses a large area of single cinnabar red or other high-purity Eastern comprehensive color fields, establishing no real spatial perspective. The scene revolves around a highly explicit symbolic action, such as touching the forehead, handing over an object, pointing, stroking, or bowing, letting the action itself carry spirituality or allegory. Add cyan-green, gold, swirling clouds, Ruyi patterns, or classical borders to parts of the clothing, forming a visual fusion between Gongbi figure painting and modern minimalist posters.

promptZh: 角色 / 主体，工笔白描插画 x 东方寓言叙事 x 日式绘画风格的生物细节描绘。主体由极细的墨线和透明浅色塑造；皮肤、手部、头发或织物通过高密度定向细线表现，细节精准但保持整体平面感。背景采用大面积单一朱砂红或其他高纯度东方复合色块，不建立真实空间透视。图像围绕一个高度明确的象征性动作展开，如触碰额头、递送物品、指点、抚摸或鞠躬，让动作本身承载灵性或寓意。服装局部添加青绿、金色、祥云、如意纹样或古典边框，形成工笔人物画与现代极简海报之间的视觉融合。
